resources.string: Use this app on your laptop over USB, nothing to install
Connect your phone to your laptop with the Type-C charging cable, then tap the button below. The next screen shows the address to type into your laptop browser. Nothing is installed on the laptop.
USB tethering is on — type the address below in your laptop browser
USB tethering is not available on this device. Turn it on from Android Settings → Network → Hotspot & tethering, then come back here for the address.
Open Chrome, Firefox or Edge on the laptop and type this address in the address bar.

1. Connect your phone to the laptop with the Type-C charging cable. 2. Tap "Turn on USB tethering". 3. Read the address on this screen. 4. Type that address into your laptop browser.
No camera is needed and nothing is installed on the laptop.
